mechanism: Darunavir inhibits CYP3A4, increasing mefloquine plasma concentrations and neurotoxicity risk; mefloquine also has potential for QT prolongation which may be additive with protease inhibitor effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for neuropsychiatric symptoms, cardiac effects, and consider alternative antimalarials (atovaquone-proguanil or doxycycline preferred in HIV patients on darunavir).
